question: does the regional inhibitory scale, selected by maximising per-cell DSI, also maximise the population directional signal at the optomotor output stage?
readout: HS_L - HS_R over HSE, HSN, HSS, H2; intact minus T4/T5-ablated
caveat: the ablated control is not a clean additive baseline; at tf 0.5 with oinh 2 it exceeds the intact value, so signal and artifact interact rather than sum. Runs are deterministic, so no error bars are available from repetition.
